conclusion: No remaining blocking issue found in the final generator within the reviewed scope. This is not a replacement for mandatory native gates or final patch replay.

findings.observed_effect: 43/200 h=1 requests and 4/200 w=2 requests failed at index1/medium despite feasible unbound dimensions. Explicit palette_size and inferred custom-palette cardinality both require the same capacity reasoning.
findings.resolution: Condition free dimensions on the required distinct-color count; reject only fully incompatible supplied constraints.
findings.title: Feasible partial overrides were rejected after randomly drawing an undersized free dimension
